name: jMaster RSI
summary: jMaster RSI is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that generates trade signals from RSI overbought/oversold levels combined with trend filtering. It opens buy positions when RSI exits oversold territory and sell positions when RSI exits overbought territory, typically incorporating additional confirmation filters. The EA operates systematically with configurable RSI parameters and risk settings.
summary_zh: jMaster RSI是一个基于动量的智能交易系统，通过RSI超买超卖水平结合趋势过滤生成交易信号。当RSI从超卖区域回升时开多仓，从超买区域回落时开空仓，并通常结合额外的确认过滤器。该EA以系统化方式运行，具有可配置的RSI参数和风险设置。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于RSI动量反转概念，利用RSI指标识别超买超卖状态作为入场信号的基础。入场条件方面，当RSI从超卖区域（通常低于30）向上穿越时触发买入信号，当RSI从超买区域（通常高于70）向下穿越时触发卖出信号。出场条件通常依赖固定止盈止损或RSI回归中性区域来平仓，部分版本可能加入移动止盈功能。仓位管理方面，该EA支持固定手数交易，可能包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算功能。资金管理方面，通过可配置的止损止盈比例控制单笔风险，但具体实现取决于是否包含账户权益百分比风控模块。整体策略属于典型的动量反转风格，在震荡行情中表现较好，但在强趋势行情中可能遭遇连续止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RSI momentum reversal concept, using the RSI indicator to identify overbought and oversold conditions as the foundation for entry signals. For entry conditions, a buy signal is triggered when RSI crosses upward from the oversold zone (typically below 30), and a sell signal is triggered when RSI crosses downward from the overbought zone (typically above 70). Exit conditions generally rely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or RSI returning to neutral territory, with some versions potentially including a trailing stop feature. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance. Money management controls per-trade risk through configurable stop-loss and take-profit ratios, though the specific implementation depends on whether an equity percentage risk module is included. The overall strategy follows a typical momentum reversal style, performing well in ranging markets but potentially suffering consecutive losses during strong trending conditions.

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，基于经典RSI指标，易于理解和验证
参数可配置性强，交易者可根据不同品种和时间框架调整RSI周期和阈值
动量反转策略在震荡市中具有统计学优势，胜率相对较高
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, based on the classic RSI indicator, easy to understand and verify
High configurability with parameters allowing traders to adjust RSI period and thresholds for different instruments and timeframes
Momentum reversal strategy has a statistical edge in ranging markets with relatively high win rates
cons: 单一RSI指标缺乏趋势过滤，在强趋势行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号
默认止损可能为0或设置不合理，存在较大的资金风险敞口
缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓导致过度交易
cons_en: Single RSI indicator lacks trend filtering, prone to frequent false signals during strong trending markets
Default stop-loss may be 0 or improperly set, creating significant capital risk exposure
Lacks new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar leading to over-trading
improvements: 增加趋势过滤指标（如均线或MACD），避免逆势交易提高信号质量
实现基于账户权益百分比的自适应仓位管理，替代固定手数以优化资金管理
improvements_en: Add a trend filter indicator (such as moving average or MACD) to avoid counter-trend trades and improve signal quality
Implement equity percentage-based adaptive position sizing instead of fixed lots to optimize money management

risk_points: 单一RSI指标在趋势行情中容易产生连续亏损信号
止损设置可能缺失或不足，单笔交易风险敞口较大
risk_points_en: Single RSI indicator prone to generating consecutive losing signals in trending markets
Stop-loss may be missing or insufficient, creating large per-trade risk exposure
